row: Welcome to the official channel of Dr. Morgan, a dedicated veterinary internal medicine specialist with over 22 years of clinical experience. I've operated on thousands of animals and seen what chronic disease looks like from the inside. Now I share the truth about pet health that most owners never hear — the hidden ingredients destroying your dog's organs, the cheap supplements that actually work, and the simple changes that add years to your pet's life. No fluff, no sponsorships. Just evidence-based guidance your vet wishes they had time to give you. New videos every week. Your pet deserves this.
